# SVG font collection fixture

This new two-face collection derives from the fixed KaTeX Main Regular/Bold assets. It is licensed under SIL OFL 1.1; retain the adjacent license and original notices. The derived display and PostScript names use Notepads.Markdown Fixture. Original fonts remain unchanged. PROVENANCE-V1.json records source hashes, independent expected metrics, preserved table hashes and the exact generator version.

The 2026-11-15 namespace migration changed only font name records and the required
checksum adjustment. Glyph, metric and other table bytes are preserved. The output
identity below is current; its original imported identity is retained separately.
